title: overFunctor derivedRestrictionIso
statement:
For a ring sheaf R on a site and U in the site, exact module restriction induces a functor on derived categories. Assuming the displayed sheafification and derived-category structures, its value at E is canonically isomorphic to the chosen-representative definition of derived restriction of E to U.

Precise quantified statement:
def overFunctor_derivedRestrictionIso
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}) (U : C)
    [HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}]
    [(J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max u v r} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max u v r} (R.over U))]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max u v r} R)) :
    let _ : PreservesFiniteLimits (overFunctor.{max u v r} R U) :=
      (overFunctor_exact_ofUniverses R U).1
    let _ : PreservesFiniteColimits (overFunctor.{max u v r} R U) :=
      (overFunctor_exact_ofUniverses R U).2
    ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses R U E ≅
      (overFunctor.{max u v r} R U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E

Notions used: [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves].

proof.text: Exactness supplies the induced derived functor. Use mapDerivedCategoryFactors at the chosen representative, then apply the derived functor to its canonical isomorphism with E.
